source_quote: So to clarify the architecture in my head, the beautiful visual canvas diagram of concepts we built in the ontology interface, and the physical materialized graph database sitting in OneLake are doing two completely different jobs. Precisely. The visual diagram is the conceptual map of meaning for the AI. The materialized graph is a specialized physical execution path for deep relationship questions. And the routing intelligence chooses the path based on this specific structure of the question being asked.
